question: Which trend is found about the distance between the galaxies?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Increasing**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **distance between galaxies** is observed to be **increasing.**
 
• It is a **phenomenon** that aligns **with the concept of the expanding universe.**
 
• This trend is a **cornerstone of modern cosmology**, rooted in observations that galaxies are moving away from each other
 
• It is a **discovery** famously attributed to **Edwin Hubble in the 1920s. **
 
• This **expansion suggests** that the **universe began from a highly dense and hot state.**
 
• **It is **often referred to as the** Big Bang **and has been spreading out ever since.
 
• Therefore, the increasing separation between galaxies serves as **key evidence for the expansion of the universe**
